name: Data FX Online
summary: Dialup ISP/online services (est. 1996, Data FX Online Pty Ltd); brand retired ~2002, entity renamed GCOMM PTY LTD (still active, ACN 074 440 841).

events.details: Data FX Online Pty Ltd established 1996 (ACN 074440841); datafx.com.au live dialup ISP by May 1997. Entity later renamed GCOMM Pty Ltd.

refs.label: ABR: Data FX Online Pty Ltd ABN 16 074 440 841

events.details: Data FX Online brand retired ~2002; the entity (ACN 074 440 841) was renamed GCOMM Pty Ltd and remains active per ABR. Current c. 2002 is far too early (site fully live through 2006); the brand was retired via the company's rename to General Communications, with the canonical site going to redirect between Aug 2006 and Feb 2007.

refs.label: Last full branded homepage on www, 13 Aug 2006
By 19 Feb 2007 www redirects to the renamed company (General Communications Business Pty Ltd, same ACN 074 440 841); bare domain webmail-only thereafter
Stale www2 mirror kept serving the brand until 18 Jul 2008; →gcomm.com.au by Jun 2017
